messages:
nina: Quick callout 1: we need a crisp GA SLA + minimal runbook for 'Sentry' feature. Can we agree key numbers in this thread?
carl: Proposed SLA: Hosted uptime 99.95%, p99 latency <= 300ms for short requests (<256 tokens). For long requests note degraded tails.
jess: Support tiers: Standard = email within 24h, Premium = 1h response + phone. Premium customers get higher quota and optional dedicated pool.
ops-bot: Canary requirement: 15m steady probe, p95 < 250ms, error rate < 0.2%. Include health-check curl in runbook.
nina: Docs checklist: SLA page, runbook (canary steps, rollback triggers), sales blurb, and telemetry dashboard links. I can draft SLA page if numbers are final.
carl: Also publish quota mapping: dev=20rps, standard=60rps burst 300, premium=200rps sustained. Overages: soft-throttle at 1.2x, reject at 1.5x.
jess: Sales wants a one-page friendly summary + appendix with technical SLOs. I'll draft the summary.
ops-bot: Add escalation: S1 paging, S2 oncall email within 4h, S3 ticket.
nina: Action items: Nina -> public SLA text; Carl -> final SLO yaml + quota table; Jess -> sales one-pager; Ops -> runbook canary snippet. Target: EOD Thu.
carl: :thumbsup: will share SLO yaml by Wed noon.
nina: Ok closing thread, quick sync tomorrow 09:15 if anything blocks.
